label: Diagram 1
caption: Diagram 1 Requirement RA1 – schematic example of gigabit-ready physical infrastructure from the network termination point to the network distribution point
description: This schematic diagram illustrates the gigabit-ready physical infrastructure connection between two main points. A thin horizontal line runs across the middle of the drawing. On the left, a grey house-shaped icon sits on this line and is labelled "Network termination point (for each dwelling in building, see Diagrams 5 and 6)". Below the icon is the text "Dwelling/building containing more than one dwelling". A green line runs from a small green circle inside the house shape down and to the right, to a small green circle on the horizontal line, with the text "Access point/ common access point" to the right of this circle. From this access point the green line runs down, then horizontally to the right, then up to a second green circle on the horizontal line; the horizontal part of this line is labelled "Gigabit-ready physical infrastructure (ducting)". The second green circle is adjacent to a white square box on the horizontal line, with the text "Network distribution point" above the box. From this box a solid black line runs down and to the right, labelled "Gigabit-capable public electronic communications network (spine network)". A green banner at the bottom reads "Diagram 1 Requirement RA1 – schematic example of gigabit-ready physical infrastructure from the network termination point to the network distribution point".
